svg.title: Playstation cross: custom controller prompt
svg.desc: Editable vector companion to the port-authored Xbox masters. Preserves the original canvas and control placement; uses PlayStation symbols and labels. No embedded bitmap, external font, filter or recovered Sony artwork.
